ms.report:
Dear reviewers, 
Please find Milestone 4 submission evidence in this GitHub repo. 
The repository includes the following:
・Attendance Logs & Training Materials 
・PoC Submissions
・Technical Architecture Docs
・Impact Measurement Frameworks
・Roadmaps
・Debugging & Testing Reports
・Market Penetration Strategies
・Feedback Reports
・Cohort 1 Performance Evaluation Report.pdf
・Integration Report
・Partnerships
・Progress Report
・Cohort 2 Selection and Onboarding.pdf

In addition, we are delighted to share that our Cohort 1 teams were invited to participate in the Blockchain Impact Forum, organized by the Blockchain for Good Alliance (BGA) in Copenhagen.
Our teams made an outstanding impression winning 9 out of 11 awards across various categories:
 🏆 Draper University Award – Plastiks
 🏆 GSR Foundation Award – Genius Tags
 🏆 Nordic Blockchain Association Awards – Cladfy and Zengate
 🏆 Cointelegraph Awards – Plastiks and Zengate
 🏆 BGA Top 3 Awards – Genius Tags, Plastiks, Zengate
Awards Details
The SDG Blockchain Accelerator Showcase partners, Blockchain for Good Alliance (BGA), Cointelegraph, Nordic Blockchain Association (NBA), GSR Foundation, and Draper University, will recognize and support outstanding teams through the following awards and opportunities:
Blockchain for Good Alliance (BGA) - Among the 10 teams presenting at the SDG Blockchain Accelerator Showcase, the Top 3 projects will be selected by BGA to receive:
・Direct entry into the BGA Incubation 2026 Spring Cohort, including:
・USD 10,000 equity-free grant per team
・Mentorship and tailored support in areas such as go-to-market strategy, business development, and tokenomics
・Visibility and exposure via BGA, Bybit, and partner communication channels
・Potential consideration for the 2026 Ascend Program, offering up to USD 50,000 in additional grants
・BGA Award: USD 2,000 recognition incentive per team (to be awarded to Solution Maker teams)

GSR Foundation - The GSR Foundation will award USD 10,000 to the winning team
